name: Sonic Pro — Rapport hebdomadaire des demandes du site

parameters.query: WITH boundary AS (SELECT date_trunc('week',now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') AS local_end), period AS (SELECT (local_end-interval '7 days') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto' AS start_at,local_end AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto' AS end_at FROM boundary), requests AS (SELECT m.* FROM public.sonicpro_hostinger_messages m,period p WHERE m.workflow_id='3v0xFd3DTeK7T34W:hostinger' AND m.source_form_match AND m.state<>'system_test' AND m.created_at>=p.start_at AND m.created_at<p.end_at) SELECT (SELECT to_char(min(created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto','YYYY-MM-DD') FROM public.sonicpro_hostinger_messages WHERE workflow_id='3v0xFd3DTeK7T34W:hostinger') AS tracking_since,to_char(p.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto','YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_start_date,to_char((p.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')-interval '1 day','YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_last_date,p.start_at AS period_start,p.end_at AS period_end,'sonicpro:'||to_char(p.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto','YYYY-MM-DD') AS report_key,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests) AS total_requests,(SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(customer_email)) FROM requests WHERE customer_email IS NOT NULL AND customer_email<>'') AS distinct_submitted_emails,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE decision='process') AS approved_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE reply_sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS acknowledged_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE urgency='urgent') AS urgent_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE urgency='uncertain') AS urgency_unknown,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE state='suspicious') AS rejected_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE state='pending_review') AS pending_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE state='delivery_failed') AS delivery_failures,(SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE state IN ('processing','sending')) AS in_progress,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_contacts c WHERE c.created_at>=p.start_at AND c.created_at<p.end_at) AS new_crm_contacts,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_contacts) AS total_crm_contacts,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.sonicpro_hostinger_messages WHERE workflow_id='3v0xFd3DTeK7T34W:hostinger' AND source_form_match AND state='pending_review') AS pending_backlog FROM period p;

const r=$json;const count=k=>{const n=Number(r[k]);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<0)throw new Error('Invalid aggregate '+k);return n;};const text='📊 Sonic Pro — Rapport hebdomadaire
'+r.period_start_date+' au '+r.period_last_date+' (Montréal)
Catégorie : Intervention_Depuis_site_web
Historique enregistré depuis : '+String(r.tracking_since||'aucun message')+'

Demandes du site enregistrées : '+count('total_requests')+'
Courriels clients distincts soumis : '+count('distinct_submitted_emails')+'
Demandes approuvées : '+count('approved_requests')+'
Avec accusé envoyé : '+count('acknowledged_requests')+'
Urgentes selon le message/IA : '+count('urgent_requests')+'
Urgence indéterminée : '+count('urgency_unknown')+'
En attente de validation : '+count('pending_requests')+'
Refusées / suspectes : '+count('rejected_requests')+'
Échecs d’envoi : '+count('delivery_failures')+'
Traitement en cours : '+count('in_progress')+'

Nouveaux contacts CRM approuvés : '+count('new_crm_contacts')+'
Total contacts CRM : '+count('total_crm_contacts')+'
Attente de validation, toutes dates : '+count('pending_backlog')+'

Statuts constatés au moment du rapport. Les réservations Google Agenda ne sont pas mesurées ici. Aucun nom, téléphone ou courriel client n’est publié dans ce rapport.';return [{json:{...r,text},pairedItem:{item:0}}];

parameters.query: WITH claimed AS (INSERT INTO public.sonicpro_weekly_reports(report_key,period_start,period_end) VALUES($1,$2::timestamptz,$3::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING report_key) SELECT $4::jsonb AS report FROM claimed;
UPDATE public.sonicpro_weekly_reports SET state='sent',telegram_message_id=$2::bigint,sent_at=now() WHERE report_key=$1 AND state='sending' RETURNING report_key,state;
UPDATE public.sonicpro_weekly_reports SET state='failed' WHERE report_key=$1 AND state='sending' RETURNING report_key,state;

parameters.content:
# Reporting hebdomadaire
Lundi 09:00 America/Toronto. Semaine complète précédente lundi–dimanche, bornes calculées en heure locale (DST inclus).

Rapport agrégé seulement, canal -1004462159492. Pas de coordonnées clients. Les statuts sont observés à la date du rapport ; aucun indicateur de réservation Agenda sans intégration dédiée.

Le déclencheur manuel permet de prévisualiser sans envoyer. Une seule publication automatique par semaine ; un échec nécessite inspection avant relance. Définir le fuseau du workflow America/Toronto avant publication.
